content: GNOME integrates IBus via org.gnome.desktop.input-sources: sources is an array of tuples ('xkb',layout) or ('ibus',engine-name); engines must be added as sources to become selectable (gsettings set ... sources "[('ibus','engine'),('xkb','us')]"). Only the ACTIVE source's engine receives key events; on this machine sources are [('xkb','us'),('xkb','ru')] meaning custom engines see nothing until selected. ibus list-engine must show the engine for it to be addable. GNOME hides/handles engine visibility; mru-sources/current keys have quirks.
